definition.description: REV | Narrative | Scrub Free-Text (Automation #5, wbs:5.3/5.6; TAD rev 22, ADR-075). The extractor labels, one prompt rewrites, a second corrects spelling, checks P1/P2/P3 decide the write. See notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. Recipient of the redaction review message (FR-030, C-TECH-047).
Environment variable. Base URL of the REV Grant Administration app; the card buttons append pagetype, etn and id (C-TECH-047).

When_an_application_status_changes.description: Row MODIFIED on rev_application, filtered to rev_status (message 3, scope 4, runas 3 as REVSafeguardingActionCompletion). Secured outputs: the row carries Tier 4 text.

Stop_unless_eligible_for_panel.description: TAD 5.5: runs when the status becomes Eligible for Panel (6). Every other status change exits here, before anything is read.

Initialise_reasons.description: Fixed reason codes only (rules 7), never text. Safe to log and notify.

Initialise_scores.description: The lowest extractor score of each labelled column; 2 means none.

Initialise_any_scrubbed.description: True once the extractor answered for a column: no-model-detections can apply (rules D-2).

Scrub_free_text.description: One scope, so one failure handler catches everything below it (ADR-075 item 9).

Get_the_application.description: Re-reads the row: the 12 raw/redacted pairs and the release flag. Secured outputs: Tier 4 narrative text (C-DOM-004, check 11).

Stop_run_already_released.description: Rules 7a rule 1: a released record is never touched - no counterpart, flag or score changes.

Compose_constants.description: The 12 column pairs, the extractor's label set (one place: change a label here), type codes, number words, P2's fixed grammar and label words (ADR-076 item 3), P3's street and practice words.

Read_redaction_settings.description: TAD 5.5.1: every rev_setting row, kept to Redaction* below. An absent row is the safe value. ADR-078: modifiedon is no longer read.

Filter_redaction_settings.description: ADR-074: only Redaction* rows take part in the guard rails, matched without regard to case.

Select_street_word_lines.description: ADR-074 items 3-4: one entry per line in residue form; a blank line is '#', a bad line '#bad#' (the row is then ignored).

Select_practice_word_lines.description: As the street words, for RedactionPracticeWordsExtra.

Select_neutral_term_lines.description: ADR-076: RedactionNeutralTerms, one 'word = neutral word' (or 'word = first or second') per line. The word, as typed, is P3's gendered list; '#bad#' makes the row invalid.

Select_neutral_term_targets.description: ADR-076 item 2: the neutral words of each valid line ('first or second' gives both): P2's closed list, so the rewrite may write exactly these.

Filter_neutral_targets_that_are_terms.description: ADR-076 item 5: a neutral word that is also a word to replace makes RedactionNeutralTerms invalid (the prompt would write a word P3 then flags).

Select_title_lines.description: ADR-076: RedactionTitles, one title per line, 1 to 10 letters with an optional full stop, kept with its capitals for P3's title check.

List_postcode_districts.description: ADR-073, now only for the residual-district check: the register, once per run. A-NS-21: one response holds all rows. A failed read is postcode-register-unavailable.

Select_register_codes.description: A failed read gives no rows, which fails closed below.

Compose_postcode_register.description: ADR-073 items 1-2: '|AB1|AB10|...|', tested with contains(). Fewer than 3,000 rows means the seed did not run: postcode-register-unavailable.

Select_column_reasons.description: Rules 7a: a column whose counterpart already has text is the grant admin's and is not rewritten; one over 5,000 characters is not scrubbed (ADR-075 item 1). Codes only.

Filter_columns_to_scrub.description: Scrub a column only with raw text, an empty counterpart and at most 5,000 characters; only when all four rule rows are valid (ADR-076 item 5) and RedactionPromptStage is not off.

For_each_column.description: One pass per column to scrub, at most 12. Sequential: the reasons and scores variables are shared.

Extract_entities_from_the_column.description: ADR-075 item 1: one AI Builder entity extraction call per column, no windows. A-NS-13 operation; A-NS-5 language en; A-NS-12 secured both ways.

Compose_entities.description: A-NS-16: the entity array at either documented-looking path. A-NS-34: null after a failed call. Null - failed or unreadable - is ai-error, never 'no entities'.

Label_rewrite_and_check_the_column.description: Only when the extractor answered: otherwise ai-error, nothing is sent to the prompts and nothing is written.

Select_entities.description: Each entity's type, offsets and score, and its value normalised (lower case, punctuation to spaces). Offsets clamped to the text here (A-NS-2). Secured: values are narrative text.

Select_raw_classes.description: Iteration 11: the column with every ASCII letter as A and every other character as itself, plus one space. Read by the name-span widening and P3's name-fragment check. Secured: narrative text.

Compose_raw_classes.description: Letter classes as one string, padded: column char i is at i + 1. A-NS-40: first()/last() of a string give one char; indexOf()/lastIndexOf() its position. Secured: inputs only, as a Compose must be (0x80060467).

Select_entity_ages.description: FR-027: the age an Age value states, in its first three words; -1 when none. A name only: 'trim' skips a leading Dr/Dr./Doctor; 'fwd' and 'back' widen it over one fragment joined by a hyphen or apostrophe (never 's). See notes.

Compose_decision.description: ADR-078: the flow never releases. The hints, and the lowest extractor score. Flags, a score and codes: safe to log and notify (NFR-012).

Write_the_decision.description: ADR-078: review required on every scrubbed record; rev_redactionreleased is never written (only the process owner sets it). Secured both ways: the row returned holds raw narratives (A-NS-39).

Tell_the_process_owner_card.description: ADR-078, FR-030: every scrubbed record reaches the process owner, who releases it. Reference and reason codes only, never text (C-DOM-004).

Narrative ready for your review

  • Reference: @{body('Get_the_application')?['rev_name']}
  • Reasons: @{if(empty(outputs('Compose_decision')?['reasons']), 'None found by the checks', join(outputs('Compose_decision')?['reasons'], ', '))}

Open the Narrative Scrubbing tab on the application, check and correct each redacted column, then set Redaction Released. Nothing reaches a trustee until you do.

Reference and reason codes only - no name, condition or narrative is included in this message by design.

Hold_the_record_for_review.description: ADR-075 item 9, ADR-078: any failure flags the record for the process owner's review; release is never written. Secured both ways: the returned row holds the raw narratives (A-NS-39).

Compose_run_link.description: Deep link to THIS run for the alert. Same pattern as every other flow in this solution.

Alert_on_failure.description: FR-010: the application reference and the run link, never the row or any text. The step is not named (ADR-075 consequence 9).

body.text_2: Scrub_free_text failed. The failed step is in the run history (secured); open the run link.

End_the_run_as_failed.description: The run shows Failed in the history, so the failure is visible to the maker.

runError.message: The narrative scrub failed; the record is held for review.
